title: Masitinib in Combination With Riluzole for the Treatment of Patients Suffering From Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
brief_summary: The objective is to compare the efficacy and safety of masitinib in combination with riluzole in the treatment of patients suffering from Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Main inclusion criteria:

1. Familial or sporadic ALS
2. Patient diagnosed with probable of definite ALS
3. Patient treated with a stable dose of riluzole (100 mg/day) for at least 30 days prior to screening

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Patient who underwent tracheostomy and/or gastrostomy
